title: Marines rescue 14 New Yorkers at the Height of Hurricane Sandy
description: On October 29, 2012, three Marines and a sailor from the 6th Communications Battalion, based in Brooklyn, N.Y., helped the NYPD and FDNY save the lives of 14 people trapped by fire and floodwaters resulting from Hurricane Sandy. Also available in high definition.
